strongest_angle: Explore how Tononi's Integrated Information Theory evolved from a niche hypothesis into a major scientific movement, and examine the fierce countermovement and public disputes surrounding consciousness science in October 2026.

key_facts.fact: A public letter signed by 124 scholars was posted online in September 2023, arguing that the Integrated Information Theory (IIT) should be labelled as pseudoscience.
David Barbera-Tomas, Camilo Miguel Signorelli, and Adrián A. Díaz‐Faes authored a 2026 sociological study analyzing the controversy surrounding Integrated Information Theory (IIT).

Michał Klincewicz, Tony Cheng, Michael Schmitz, Miguel Ángel Sebastián, and Joel S. Snyder published a 2025 article in Nature Neuroscience discussing why Integrated Information Theory has been labeled as unscientific.
